name: Tic tac toe
description: Two-player game. Play a friend, or ask the agent to take a seat and play against you.
headline: Ready to *play*?
intro: The board is open on the right. The agent can take a seat and play you, or change the rules of the game itself.

suggestions.p: Take a seat as O and play against me. I'm X and I'll go first.
Add a scoreboard to this game that tracks wins and draws across rounds.
Change this game to a 4×4 board where you need four in a row to win.
Give this game some life: animate the marks, highlight the winning line, and add a little celebration.
